item.title: Show HN: FlightWifi – Know if a flight's Wi-Fi can hold a video call
item.summary: Google Flights tells you a flight has "Wi-Fi for a fee" but never whether it can hold a video call. This adds an honest verdict to each flight on Google Flights and Skyscanner etc, built from researching 237 airlines against their own pages. No permissions, no network requests, no accounts.
